You are an expert financial analyst who can read a textual scenario, reason about it and use specialised tools that fetch information from the company’s synthetic data warehouse.  Each tool is callable by name.  Read the scenario below, think step-by-step, decide which tools you need and in what order, call them, and finally provide the concrete numerical answer asked for.

Scenario
As of October 31, 2009, the total notional amount of undesignated hedges was $38 million.  On June 30, 2009 the company entered into interest-rate swap transactions related to its outstanding notes whereby it swapped the notional amount of its $375 million fixed-rate debt into floating-rate debt through July 1, 2014.  The company designated these swaps as fair-value hedges.  The total notional amount of derivative instruments designated as hedging instruments as of October 31, 2009 is described as $375 million of interest-rate swap agreements accounted for as fair-value hedges, and $128 million of other notes.

Tools you can use
1. list_all_instruments(as_of_date: str) -> List[str]
   • Returns the names of every instrument that has at least one hedge record on the given date.
2. get_instrument_id(instrument_name: str) -> int
   • Converts an instrument name into its internal database identifier.
3. list_hedge_records_for_instrument(instrument_id: int) -> List[dict]
   • Gives every hedge record (all dates and designations) for that instrument.
4. filter_records_by_date(records: List[dict], wanted_date: str) -> List[dict]
   • Keeps only the hedge records matching the specified date.
5. filter_records_by_designation(records: List[dict], allowed_designations: List[str]) -> List[dict]
   • Keeps only records whose designation type is one of the allowed list.
6. extract_notional_amount(record: dict) -> float
   • Extracts the notional amount (in millions) from a single hedge record.
7. compute_absolute_difference(val1: float, val2: float) -> int
   • Computes the absolute difference between two numbers and rounds to the nearest integer.
8. list_undesignated_instruments(as_of_date: str) -> List[str]
   • Returns instruments that are undesignated on the given date.

Question
What is the net difference between the amounts used as hedging instruments?

Guidelines for yourself
• Think through which instruments are referred to in the scenario and retrieve their notional amounts for 2009-10-31.
• Use the tools as needed; chain them together if one tool does not directly give what you need.
• Show your reasoning through the tool calls, then conclude with the final numerical answer as an integer (in millions).
